title.en: An Act Appropriating Annually the Sum of One Hundred Thousand Pesos as Aid to the Music Promotion Foundation
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Annually the Sum of One Hundred Thousand Pesos as Aid to the Music Promotion Foundation

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1958/ra_2086_1958.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby appropriated annually, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos as aid of the Government to the Music Promotion Foundation in the prosecution of the objectives of the said Foundation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1958.
